items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I can hear of ... Charlie Shavers ... who was with me in Europe. He's gone, too.

ctx.x: And we alternated with the Gay '90s lady singers, we had the jazz. And after a while the whole place -- got rid of the Gay '90s and we hired another jazz band, there were two bands alternating and the joint was jumping because up on the second floor was another joint, they had Gene Krupa up there and we had Charlie Shavers up there, oh, there was big
